name: Pikes Peak 2019

venue.name: Discovery Canyon High School
venue.address: 1810 North Gate Blvd Colorado Springs, Colorado
venue.details: Common Area. Please park near and enter through the 9-12 entrance, follow signs and directions from persons.

information:
Please note that this event can only accommodate 90 competitors. We also ask that guests be kept to a minimum to ensure enough room for the competitors. Be sure to register early to guarantee a spot!

All students and staff of Discovery Canyon High School are exempt from the registration fee. Please see the registration requirements below for more information.
